summary: Achievement Badges feature fully tested - all backend APIs and frontend UI working correctly. 21/21 backend tests passed. Frontend shows badges with proper earned/unearned states, progress bars, featured badge selection, and Check for New Badges functionality.
passed_tests: GET /api/badges/all returns 200 with 10 badges
GET /api/badges/all returns correct schema (id, name, description, icon, color, criteria, reward_coins)
GET /api/badges/all contains all 10 expected badges (first_steps, marathon_master, early_adopter, super_referrer, series_slayer, vip_member, mission_ace, night_owl, big_spender, loyal_viewer)
GET /api/badges/leaderboard returns 200 with list
GET /api/badges/my-badges requires authentication (401 without token)
GET /api/badges/my-badges returns 200 with auth
GET /api/badges/my-badges returns correct schema (badges, total_earned, total_available, featured_badges)
GET /api/badges/my-badges calculates progress correctly (Early Adopter at 100%)
POST /api/badges/check requires authentication (401 without token)
POST /api/badges/check returns 200 with auth
POST /api/badges/check returns correct schema (newly_earned, total_reward, total_badges)
POST /api/badges/check awards Early Adopter badge for users in first 90 days
PUT /api/badges/featured requires authentication (401 without token)
PUT /api/badges/featured rejects more than 3 badges (400 error)
PUT /api/badges/featured rejects unearned badges (400 error)
PUT /api/badges/featured updates featured badges successfully
PUT /api/badges/featured changes persist in GET /api/badges/my-badges
Achievement Badges section visible on Profile page when logged in
Badges display with lock icon for unearned badges
Progress bars shown for in-progress badges
Check for New Badges button triggers badge check and shows toast
Featured badges can be selected via Edit button
Featured badges save successfully with toast confirmation
Earned badges show checkmark indicator
Featured badges show star indicator
How to Earn Badges section displays badge descriptions
